professionalSummary.text: Develops and maintains the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed and maintained the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application (TypeScript, Angular), including the server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced the full-queue download.

experienceHighlights.text: Owns the component and end-to-end test suites for the application and keeps them passing in the pipeline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Cuts alert-queue load time for analysts, reported against the published performance baseline.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Median alert-queue load time for analysts fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by the application's real-user monitoring over the following four weeks against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds.

skills.text: Coordinates API changes with the backend team and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated API changes with the backend team in the API review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the views to the paged endpoints.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's development and maintenance of the alert queue and case views, ownership of test suites, reduction in load time, coordination of API changes, and documentation of release limitations. They do not establish the candidate's ability to cut load time against the published baseline or the exact performance metrics.

evidence.text: Developed and maintained the alert queue and case views of the compliance web application (TypeScript, Angular), including the server-side paging and column virtualisation that replaced the full-queue download.
Owned the component test suite (Jest) and the end-to-end suite (Cypress) for the application, keeping both passing in the pipeline and adding a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.

Median alert-queue load time for analysts fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by the application's real-user monitoring over the following four weeks against the published baseline of 6.2 seconds.
Coordinated API changes with the backend team in the API review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the views to the paged endpoints.

Wrote the release notes for each application release, including the known limitation that column sorting was applied per page rather than across the whole queue, and the hand-over notes for the frontend on-call.
